plan: docs/plans/phase3.md 3H (prereq_cohort_only, A2-12, A3-7); prereq semantics (ii) = prerequisite IS NULL or cohort-only
rule: A prerequisite text is cohort-only iff, after `normalise`, deleting every match of every pattern in `remove` (in order, each match replaced by one space) leaves only characters matched by `remainder`. NULL is not cohort-only (semantics (ii) adds NULL separately).

normalise.why: EduRec glues connectors to words (DegreeTHENmust, (Hons)ANDmust); upper-case only, so programme names are untouched

remove.name: degree-wrapper
remove.pattern: \b(?:if|must be) undertaking an? (?:undergraduate degree|graduate degree(?: coursework| research)?)\b(?: then\b)?
remove.why: the degree-type condition every rule starts with; a degree type is a programme restriction

remove.name: cohort
remove.pattern: \bmust (?:not )?be in one of the cohorts (?:from|to|prior to|after|before|between) \d{4}(?: (?:and|to) \d{4})?(?: inclusive)?

remove.name: programme
remove.why: a programme restriction: one programme code (e.g. 0200ACCHON) or a list of them, up to the next clause

notCohortOnly: must have completed … (any course, A-level or test requirement)
the student must have achieved … units / a GPA
if in one of the cohorts … THEN <another requirement> (conditional, not a restriction)
